correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact update \(D_p(bp^m)=bmp^{m-1}\). Below \(p\) and strictly between \(p\) and \(2p\), no intermediate valuation is divisible by \(p\), so the factorial formulas are exact; \(m=p\) is fixed. The half-line \(m\ge2p\) is forward invariant because \(m-1+\nu_p(m)\ge2p\), including \(m=2p\), and there \(|D_p(x)|/|x|=m/p\ge2\). Edge cases \(e=0\), \(p=2\), negative coefficients, and both threshold endpoints are covered. The bundled checker passed 786314 assertions.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete and sharp phase diagram for every integer orbit of \(D_p\) using only the initial \(p\)-adic valuation: exact extinction below \(p\), exact fixed-point landing on \([p,2p-1]\), and at least doubling above \(2p\). It replaces a qualitative eventual classification with exact basin boundaries, stopping times, terminal values, and quantitative growth, clarifying the one-prime model that motivates harder arithmetic-derivative dynamics.
